headline: Acer Reports 92% Year-on-Year Net Income Growth for Q3 2026
summary: Acer Inc. announced third-quarter 2026 net income of NT$2.13 billion, marking its highest quarterly profit in five years and a 92.3% increase compared to the same period last year.
why: Acer is a significant global hardware manufacturer, and its earnings provide insight into the health of the consumer electronics and PC market.

impacts.name: Acer Inc.
impacts.why: Strong earnings growth typically leads to positive market reaction for the equity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The significant year-on-year profit growth exceeding five-year highs indicates strong operational performance, likely driving investor interest.
